mutants.note: Uses half-even instead of documented half-up interest rounding; a tie at the half-cent must be checked.
Uses a 360-day year instead of 365; a full-year or fractional-year calculation must check the denominator.
Quantizes interest to one decimal place rather than cents; the returned Decimal scale must be checked.
Turns a negative fee into a positive charge; invalid fee signs must be rejected without posting.
Treats a transaction at the statement start as opening balance rather than period movement.
Excludes a transaction at the statement end; the final instant must be included.
Rejects a debit that lands exactly on the configured overdraft limit.
Raises on a repeated transaction id instead of returning the original posting and leaving one row.
Drops the guard against reversing an already reversed transaction.
Swaps debit and credit columns in CSV output.

refactors.note: same behaviour, new internals: constants renamed, rounding and system-account helpers extracted
